title: QUIC RFC 9000 ECN Packet-Number-Space Separation Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests over ACK-generation ECN state partitioning, coverage triage regeneration, SpecTrace JSON validation, Release build, full Release no-build test execution, and diff checking.
scope: This verification covers local ACK-generation state separation for acknowledgment ranges and ECN counts across Initial, Handshake, and Application Data packet number spaces.
expected_result: Focused tests show each packet number space builds ACK frames with only its own ECN counts, an empty packet number space does not borrow state from another space, and identical numeric packet numbers in different spaces keep independent ECN totals.
procedure: Run the focused S13P4P1-0006 requirement-home filter.
Validate canonical SpecTrace JSON with the core profile.
Run the full Release no-build test suite.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: ACK-generation state has recorded ECN-marked processed packets in one or more packet number spaces.
The focused edge records the same numeric packet number in all three packet number spaces with distinct ECN markings.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim ECN validation, coalesced-packet ECN counting, endpoint interop success, public API behavior, or congestion-control response behavior.

status_summary: Local verification passed on 2026-05-08: focused S13P4P1-0006 requirement-home filter 3/3, regenerated QUIC coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S13P4P1-0006 trace_clean and reports 1,484 of 1,771 QUIC requirements trace-clean overall, SpecTrace core validation passed for 517 artifacts, Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, full Release no-build suite passed 4,843/4,843, and git diff --check passed with only generated-triage CRLF normalization warnings.
